annotations.text:
Phase 4: the two data-heavy windows move to WebView2 pages hosted in native frames. Same palette and type as the native windows; the Dark switch and Accent swatch on each artboard preview the theme handoff.
History: search with Partial/Exact, sortable columns, a preview pane that replaces the separate Preview window, keyboard shortcuts on the action buttons.

Organizer: channels on the left, clips in the middle, preview and clip properties on the right. Move to… and Copy to… open an in-page picker instead of the old Select Channel window; drag and drop between channels does the same. Channel delete and rename are in-page cards.
If the WebView2 runtime is missing, a native dialog links to the installer; the tray app keeps running.

Tray menu: a custom popup card like the Windows 11 Explorer context menu. Icon row with the everyday actions (toggles light up when on), a header with the active channel that opens About, then the text items; submenus open beside the card. Esc, click-outside and focus loss close it; arrows and Enter work. An ini switch brings the standard menu back.
